clips.title: 八成中国工厂挤在园区：零碳园区试点已铺开，五年换掉煤电底座？
title_lines: 八成中国工厂挤在园区
title_highlights: 八成中国工厂挤在园区

subtitles.en: In Inomongolia, a region deep in inland China, you'll find cows, grasslands, this little buddy,
subtitles.zh: 在中国内陆深处的内蒙古，你会看到奶牛、草原、这个小家伙，

subtitles.en: and a possible model for a carbon-free future.
subtitles.zh: 以及一个可能实现零碳未来的模式。

subtitles.en: China is the world's largest exporter of goods, 80% of Chinese factories, which manufacture everything from your smartphone
subtitles.zh: 中国是全球最大的商品出口国，80%的中国工厂生产从智能手机

subtitles.en: to industrial chemicals to Labubus, sit inside industrial parks, especially zone districts that draw on a shared power supply.
subtitles.zh: 到工业化学品再到拉布布等各种产品，这些工厂位于工业园区内，尤其是共享电力供应的专区。

subtitles.en: These industrial clusters are responsible for approximately 50% of China's GDP, but they come at a cost.
subtitles.zh: 这些产业集群贡献了中国约50%的GDP，但也付出了代价。

subtitles.en: China is still the carbon emitters globally.
subtitles.zh: 中国仍是全球碳排放的主要来源。

subtitles.en: Many Chinese factories use major coal plants to produce the products that we see around the world, but now China is trying to shift away from that.
subtitles.zh: 许多中国工厂使用大型燃煤电厂生产我们在世界各地看到的产品，但现在中国正试图摆脱这种模式。

subtitles.en: And the concept that they've focused in on is this new concept, which is the zero carbon industrial park.
subtitles.zh: 他们聚焦的概念是这个新概念——零碳工业园区。

subtitles.en: In March, 2026, China set a target to designate 100 zero carbon industrial parks over the next five years.
subtitles.zh: 2026年3月，中国设定了在未来五年内指定100个零碳工业园区的目标。

subtitles.en: These planned districts of factories are meant to share renewable power supply.
subtitles.zh: 这些规划中的工厂区旨在共享可再生能源供应。

subtitles.en: Meanwhile, private companies have paved a head with their own versions.
subtitles.zh: 与此同时，民营企业已用自身方案取得领先。

subtitles.en: We are not zero industrial park. We are 100% use renewable energy as our feedstock.
subtitles.zh: 我们不是零碳产业园，而是100%使用可再生能源作为原料。

entities.evidence: Bloomberg's own video pages confirm the publisher identity; 彭博 is the established Chinese media name for Bloomberg.
Only one Bloomberg page confirms 'Primer' as the program label; no established Chinese program name found, so keep English.

Transcript auto-caption 'Inomongolia' is a garbled rendering of Inner Mongolia; 内蒙古 is the standard Chinese form. Chinese-name confirmation rests on general usage rather than a snippet explicitly pairing the two.
Labubu is the Pop Mart collectible character; 拉布布 is the widely used Chinese media rendering. Plural 'Labubus' is a caption artifact, not a separate entity.
NDRC/MIIT/State Council notices use 零碳园区 as the official policy term (国家级零碳园区建设名单).

terms.sense: designated factory districts run on shared renewable power
industrial parks and special zones drawing on shared power supply
target of about 100 national-level zero-carbon parks

clip_research.source_claim: In March 2026, China set a target to designate 100 zero carbon industrial parks over the next five years.
clip_research.public_baseline: Official NDRC/MIIT/State Council notices (发改办环资〔2025〕1082号, 发改环资〔2025〕910号) published the first national batch of 52 zero-carbon parks in December 2025; a secondary summary cites a '十五五' goal of about 100 national-level parks.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript dates the 100-park target to March 2026, while public records show the pilot framework and first 52-park list already existed in December 2025; the 100-park figure appears as a '十五五' goal rather than a fresh March 2026 announcement.

china_advantage.comparison: China is the world's largest clean-tech exporter and is rolling out zero-carbon industrial parks as a policy model for green manufacturing.

evidence.fact: 80% of Chinese factories sit inside industrial parks; clusters ~50% of GDP.
March 2026 target of 100 zero-carbon industrial parks over five years.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
